name: ofDigits_inj_of_len_eq
statement: ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {L1 L2 : List ℕ} (len : L1.length = L2.length) (w1 : ∀ l ∈ L1, l < b) (w2 : ∀ l ∈ L2, l < b) (h : ofDigits b L1 = ofDigits b L2) : L1 = L2
